purpose: compare architecture options under operability and consistency constraints

parameters.name: active developers
parameters.uncertainty: may change over the decision horizon

relations_or_equations: feasible(option) iff consistency, security, operability, and delivery constraints are satisfied
observation_model: release and incident telemetry plus team workflow records
error_model: future workload and staffing are uncertain
assumptions_and_closures: current traffic does not require independently scaled services
validity_domain: current product, staffing, traffic, and regulatory regime
falsifiers: measured deployment contention dominates modular-monolith operational savings
